description: Create a shareable invite URL that points to a scheduled event, so recipients land on the event when joining. Requires the Create Instant Invite permission. Returns the invite URL; Discord may reuse a similar existing invite instead of creating a new one. EXTERNAL events need channel_id; other events reject it and use their own channel. The URL is an ordinary channel invite with ?event=<event ID> appended. Use discord_create_invite for a channel invite with the unique or temporary options.

channel_id.description: Channel (snowflake) the invite points to. Required for EXTERNAL events, which have no channel of their own. Omit it for VOICE and STAGE_INSTANCE events: they always use their own channel, and passing one fails.

event_id.description: ID (snowflake) of the scheduled event to link the invite to.

max_age.description: Invite lifetime in seconds, 0–604800 (7 days); 0 means it never expires. Default 86400 (24h).

max_uses.description: Maximum number of uses, 0–100; 0 means unlimited. Default 0.

name: discord_create_event_invite
